subject: Request: One-off POC duration + credit exception for Oak & Rowe
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Rebecca Chen <rchen@oakandrowe.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-06-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quick ask — extra pilot credits and 60-day extension?

Rebecca — thanks again for the demo yesterday. Oak & Rowe is further along than we expected on integration and they want to stress-test a batch-inference flow that will consume more tokens than the standard PLG sandbox.

They asked: can we extend the pilot from 30 days to 60 days and add 250k complimentary token credits (one-time) so they can run a production-like workload this month? Procurement also said they need a short PO/quote to lock timing.

I'm confident this is a strategic mid-market account (legal/adtech stack) and the team is committed to an early purchase decision if the pilot shows the latency/cost benefits we demoed. Can you confirm whether we can do a one-off extension + credit grant and what approval path you want?

I attached the draft quote and the pilot scope we used in the demo.

Thanks,
Markus
Senior Director, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
Attach: quote-redwood-2026-06.pdf; pilot-scope.docx
From: Rebecca Chen <rchen@oakandrowe.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement <procurement@oakandrowe.com>
Date: 2026-06-19T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask — extra pilot credits and 60-day extension?

Hi Markus — appreciate the follow-up. We ran the integration test overnight and need the larger token allocation to validate our ensemble reranker across 3M rows. The product team says 250k will get meaningful signal. Procurement is ok with a short PO once we have a quote that matches the pilot dates.

Two small asks from our security team: 1) can logs be retained for 90 days for the trial period, 2) will Redwood confirm data handling for server-side logs? If those are ok we can move quickly.

Rebecca
Director of Product, Oak & Rowe
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-06-19T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Oak & Rowe pilot requests — exec approval needed

Aditya / Lauren — forwarding Oak & Rowe thread. TL;DR: they want a one-off extension to 60 days and +250k one-time complimentary token credits. Procurement needs a PO and we should honor their request quickly if approvals in place.

Why I think this merits an exception: Oak & Rowe is an estimated $180k ARR opportunity in 12 months, strong reference potential in our adtech vertical, and they are willing to be an early integration partner. Standard PLG policy is 30 days / small credit allotment; this request is beyond that.

Proposed guardrails if we get exec approval:
- One-time 250k complimentary token credit applied as account credit, expiring 90 days after grant
- Pilot window: 2026-06-20 through 2026-08-18 (60 days)
- Billing hold during pilot; billing activates once they sign PO for committed usage or on 2026-08-19 if no PO (auto-convert to paid sandbox rates)
- Limited logs retention exception: 90 days for trial only; security to confirm redaction rules

Attachments: quote-redwood-2026-06.pdf, OakRowe_PO_Template.pdf

Need: Aditya — discretionary approval for credits? Lauren — legal/dealdesk review for the PO text and billing hold. If you want, we can include a mandatory tech review signoff from Security before the pilot begins.

—Markus
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-06-19T14:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Oak & Rowe pilot requests — exec approval needed

Markus — I reviewed the account notes and the opportunity metrics. I'm comfortable approving a conditional one-off credit and 60-day extension with the following requirements: 

1) Credits capped at 250,000 tokens, applied as account credit and auditable in Console.
2) PO required within the pilot window; procurement copy to lauren for billing hold terms. If PO not submitted by 2026-07-30, credit remains but billing will start automatically on 2026-08-19.
3) Security must sign off on the 90-day logs retention exception and provide the redaction checklist before granting access.
4) This approval is a revenue-qualified discretionary concession — require RVP/Revenue Ops signoff (Lauren) and CFO acknowledgement for exception to PLG policy.

Lauren — can you confirm Deal Desk can draft a PO template reflecting the billing hold and the pilot acceptance criteria? If so, I'll mark this as approved pending CFO acknowledgement.

Aditya
VP, Sales Operations
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-20T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Oak & Rowe pilot requests — exec approval needed

Thanks team — I reviewed the ask and the ARR projection for Oak & Rowe (RDW-2398). I approve a one-time 250k token credit and a 60-day pilot extension under these final conditions:

- Credit: 250,000 tokens issued as account credit, expiration 90 days from issuance. Finance to record a one-time concession code RDW-EXC-2398.
- Pilot window: 2026-06-20 to 2026-08-18.
- PO: procurement to provide PO; Deal Desk to apply billing hold until PO is received or until 2026-08-19 per Aditya's note.
- Security: logs retention exception for 90 days limited to trial data only; Security to provide the redaction checklist and confirm no PII retention beyond policy window.
- One follow-up: limit the complimentary credit to usage for inference (not for embeddings) — Deal Desk to enforce via configuration.

Lauren — please confirm the billing hold mechanics and that Deal Desk will stamp the PO template with the approved concession code. Markus — please send the updated quote/DocuSign to Rebecca once ans confirmed.

Rishi
CFO, Redwood Inference
